stance_rationale: Design-only framing does not satisfy the alpha critic verification matrix: alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, factor_engine_proposal.R, challenge_note, and 3-agent packages are absent. The package must revise hard-constraint handling and downgrade empirical claims before any Phase B/C Forge handoff.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: alpha_scores.parquet is missing in both requested artifact locations; qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260517_004 is absent and stage_artifacts/WT_D20260517_004 contains only four design markdown files.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Z_Score_Aligned-only is asserted in design text, but no factor_engine_proposal.R or alpha_scores artifact exists to verify absence of NEGATE_FACTORS/sign flips.
Usable_Date <= sig_date is asserted, but no IC history, alpha_scores, or lineage artifact exists for audit.
load_month_factors_v2() is specified, but no executable pipeline or artifact lineage proves Factor DB access avoided direct parquet loads.
t-1 lag is stated for regime/overlay features, but no dd_lag/vol_lag-equivalent implementation is available.
Annual May and quarterly 45d lag rules are stated only at design level; no generated factor panel proves enforcement.

critical_concerns.description: Mandatory time-series artifacts are absent: alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, and factor_engine_proposal.R cannot be inspected, so RF-A7, IC diagnostics, schedule validation, PSD, and cond <= 100 are unverified.

The proposed comp sleeve uses KR_TOP500_LIQ1E8, a 1e8 ranking floor, and blend_max_names_union=40, which conflicts with the base hard constraints of KOSPI200 union KOSDAQ150, 20d TV >= 2e8, and max_names=20 hard unless a formal charter exception is recorded.

The weakest overclaim is that zero name overlap makes cor(NAV_comp,NAV_1715) <= 0.3 by construction. Disjoint KR equity sleeves can remain highly correlated through common market, sector, liquidity, and regime exposure; L-281 TSMOM cor=0.077 is not a close analogue for two KR equity cross-section sleeves.

G1 recall recovery is speculative. WT_003 recall was 0.0893, while the four proposed fixes report expected recalls without OOS evidence; 4 options x 5 windows x 4 a_max x 9 labels creates RF-A6 multiple-testing pressure before any DSR/t_NW result exists.
No Silent Override is not complete: challenge_note.md/challenge_note_alpha-research.md are missing, codex_round_completed=false, and risk/optimization packages for WT-D20260517_004 are absent.

The academic mechanism checklist is not met cleanly: mechanism_description is 832 chars despite the <200-char rule, and several cited references are broad scaffolding rather than page-specific KR-market validation for this sleeve.

Cost and turnover claims rely on a weighted 17 bps blend estimate, but no weights.csv or turnover path verifies the <600% annual hard constraint, |Delta a_t| sleeve rebalance cost, or comp sleeve 25 bps implementation drag.

supporting_arguments: The package does explicitly preserve the WT_003 fail evidence: recall 0.0893, cor 0.9997, and cross-base mismatch.
The four design markdown artifacts define a coherent Phase B/C protocol with strict G1 and 7-axis pass/fail gates.
PIT intent is documented through t-1 lag, purge, embargo, Usable_Date, and load_month_factors_v2() requirements, but remains unverified.
unresolved_disputes: Whether Charter v1.8 design_phase_a legitimately exempts this package from alpha_scores.parquet while the alpha critic role prompt still requires time-series alpha verification.
Whether L-279 multi-sleeve precedent can override the current hard max_names=20 mandate for a 40-name NAV blend.
Whether KR_TOP500_LIQ1E8 is authorized under the base universe constraint KOSPI200 union KOSDAQ150.
weakest_assumption: The single most fragile claim is that NAV-level sleeve separation plus 0% ticker overlap makes cor(NAV_comp,NAV_1715) <= 0.3 achievable by construction.
rebuttal_required: Provide alpha_scores.parquet with Date x Ticker x score schema and >=60 monthly sig_dates, or amend the task type so the alpha critic schema does not require it.
Provide weights.csv schedule and covariance.parquet, including PSD and post-shrink condition number <=100 audit.
Document an approved exception for max_names=40 and KR_TOP500_LIQ1E8, or revise to the base hard constraints.
Produce challenge_note.md with RF-A1 through RF-A7 dispositions and artifact_lineage write_json -> record_lineage order.
Replace the cor <=0.3 by-construction claim with an empirical precondition and stress-test plan.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Current evidence is one alpha draft plus four design docs; Forge, Codex, Architect, risk, and optimizer corroboration are not present for a 2-source PASS.

alpha_specific_questions: Can the comp sleeve satisfy rank_IC >= 0.04, ICIR >= 0.20, Harvey t_NW >= 2.95, DSR >= 0.50, and monotonicity >= 0.80 after the 720+ trial search space is deflated?
Can the p_bad vector be proven PIT-clean when it consumes production NAV, M4 regime, and R05 tail regime features?
If AX-005 and AX-007 exclusions are necessary but not sufficient, what empirical Gate13/AX-001 evidence will prove conditional defense rather than a structural exemption narrative?
